key_insight: Surrogate-assisted Bayesian calibration matches stator differential-mode impedance, but successful fits require effective material parameters that deviate from datasheet values.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports early EV powertrain EMC assessment by estimating broadband machine impedance while reducing reliance on costly full-wave FE simulations.
method: Replace 3D full-wave stator FE simulations with a multi-output surrogate.
Calibrate effective material parameters using Hamiltonian Markov Chain Monte Carlo.
Use an orthogonal surrogate-compliant discrepancy term to assess material-model completeness.
evidence_signal: Against measured differential-mode impedance up to 30 MHz, two of three parameter-range scenarios achieved good agreement; datasheet-aligned parameters produced deficient results.
watch_item: Calibrated parameters are effective rather than necessarily physical material properties; rotor and common-mode impedance calibration remain future work.
paper_title: Bayesian Calibration of Effective Material Parameters in Electric Machine Stators
